title: Signorina Mimì, che dono raro
subtitle: At the Café Momus: the bonnet and the toast, Musetta arrives with Alcindoro and tries to make Marcello look at her, La bohème, Act 2

passages.label: Signorina Mimì, che dono raro: the pink bonnet; the reader of hearts (A major)
O bella età d'inganni: love sweeter than honey; the toast
Musetta arrives with Alcindoro (Allegro moderato, A flat major)
Il suo nome è Musetta: Marcello's portrait; Musetta's tantrum
Ehi! Camerier!: the plate, the laughing girls and students; Musetta's plan
Tu non mi guardi! (Un poco meno, no sharps or flats) to the waltz

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 111-129 (from figure (15), "Signorina Mimì", to the end of page 129, 188 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The print's four chorus staves are gathered here into two by voice (every note and syllable kept, each group named where it comes in). Tempo from the printed metronome mark; where none is printed, a value chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
